user.title: Find a team
user.description: Search TheSportsDB for a team. The free key, 123, is enough for fixtures and full-time results. A premium key from thesportsdb.com allows more requests a minute.

error.no_teams: No team matches. Try another spelling, or the club's full name.
error.cannot_connect: TheSportsDB did not answer. Try again in a minute.

init.title: TheSportsDB Tracker options
init.description: The result stays on the sensor for the hours given, then the next fixture shows. The next fixture also takes over the given hours before its kick-off.

data.pre_hours: Show the next fixture from (hours before kick-off)

open_app.name: Open an app on a TV
open_app.description: Opens a channel's app on a TV box through its Android Debug Bridge (or an Android TV Remote). The Team Scores card calls this when a channel is tapped.

device.name: Device
device.description: The TV to open it on: a Google Cast device with an Android Debug Bridge on the same box, the bridge itself, or an Android TV Remote.

app.name: App
app.description: The app's Android package name (no.tv2.sumo) or a link the app opens.
